analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a stack buffer overflow caused by not properly validating the length of the key before copying it into the key_record.key buffer. The function uses ZBEE_APS_CMD_KEY_LENGTH to determine the size for memcpy and memcmp, which can lead to a buffer overflow if the actual key length exceeds this value.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The issue occurs when the dissect_zbee_aps_transport_key function is called, which populates a key array of fixed size ZBEE_APS_CMD_KEY_LENGTH. If the input data contains a key larger than this expected size, the subsequent calls to zbee_sec_add_key_to_keyring will overflow the key_record.key buffer, causing a crash.
